report_name: Police and FBI Warn Public of Foreign Actors Targeting Home Routers

threat_actors.name: Federal Security Service (FSB)
threat_actors.description: State-sponsored cyber actors linked to Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) are actively compromising vulnerable home and small-business routers globally to co-opt them into a botnet-like infrastructure.
threat_actors.goals: To build a vast, geographically distributed, and resilient infrastructure for conducting a wide range of cyber operations, including anonymizing attacks and launching further attacks against other targets.

attack_patterns.name: Vulnerability Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The actors are conducting mass scans of IP address ranges to find open ports and identify vulnerable router models.

attack_patterns.name: Default Accounts
attack_patterns.description: A primary method of compromise is using well-known default credentials for router administration interfaces.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Actors exploit known, unpatched vulnerabilities in the router's web interface for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Protocol Tunneling
attack_patterns.description: Compromised routers are used to tunnel malicious traffic, hiding the true origin of the attackers.

identities.name: Montgomery County Police Department
identities.description: Amplified an FBI Joint Cybersecurity Advisory, warning residents to secure their home and small-business internet routers.

identities.name: FBI
identities.description: Issued a Joint Cybersecurity Advisory warning that state-sponsored cyber actors are compromising vulnerable routers.

identities.name: Home and Small-Business Router Users
identities.description: Owners of consumer-grade and SOHO routers that are being targeted and compromised on a global scale.

infrastructure.name: Compromised Router Botnet
infrastructure.description: A botnet-like infrastructure of compromised home and SOHO routers used to conceal malicious activities, monitor network traffic, and launch further attacks.
